message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime based on facts: kidnapping a minor under 14, abducting child, child missing. Under Chinese Criminal Law, kidnapping of a minor under 14 is "拐骗儿童罪" (kidnapping/abduction of a minor). The specific article: Criminal Law Article 240 (for kidnapping of a minor under 14). So the crime is "拐骗儿童罪". Possibly also "绑架罪"? In Chinese law, kidnapping is "绑架罪" (Article 239) for kidnapping persons for ransom, etc. For children under 14, there is a specific offense "拐骗儿童罪" (Article 240). The facts: abducted child, not for ransom, personal grievance. So "拐骗儿童罪". Provide answer in required format: [罪名]拐骗儿童罪<eoa>.
